# Documentation proposal template

Status: Approved

Classification: Template; non-canonical example.

Target: `TARGET_PATH`
Operation: `create | replace | delete | rename`
Proposal revision: `REVISION`

## Reason and affected documents

Explain the change, list affected paths, and link relevant canonical documents.

## Discrepancies and verification

Record implementation/specification mismatches and exact checks/results, including failures and unavailable checks. Do not infer approval or claim checks were run.

## Rename or deletion

For rename: identify source and destination. For deletion: state the reason. Rename with content changes requires complete final content.

## Complete proposed target content

For create/replace, delimit the complete target text, including final status metadata. Do not copy this wrapper into the target. An Approved label in proposed text is not approval.

<!-- BEGIN PROPOSED CONTENT -->
PROPOSED_CONTENT
<!-- END PROPOSED CONTENT -->

Retain proposals after application unless the owner authorizes removal or archival. Identify the proposal path/revision and target in the owner's review request.
